methodologyNotes: Covers hitch-mounted bicycle racks that insert into a vehicle receiver hitch and are sold at a published US MSRP. Excludes trunk-strap, roof, spare-tire, and truck-bed racks. Price is typical US MSRP in USD for the base 2-bike configuration where a family exists. bikeCapacity is the number of bikes the base model carries (integer). rackStyle is an enum: 'platform' (wheel trays) or 'hanging-mast' (frame arms). hitchSize is the receiver size(s) the model fits, enum: '1.25 in', '2 in', or '1.25 & 2 in'. maxBikeWeightLbs is the manufacturer per-bike weight limit in pounds; where an off-road/e-bike de-rate applies the higher on-road figure is used. maxTireWidthIn is the widest tire held without an add-on adapter, in inches. maxWheelbaseIn is the longest bike wheelbase supported, in inches. frameContact is a boolean: true if the rack clamps the bike frame, false if it secures wheels/tires only. foldFlat is a boolean: true if the rack folds vertically against the vehicle when not loaded. tiltAway is a boolean: true if the rack tilts down/back for rear-cargo access while loaded. integratedLock is a boolean: true if built-in bike locks are included. addOnCapable is a boolean: true if the model accepts add-on trays/extensions to increase capacity. rackWeightLbs is the shipping/assembled weight of the rack itself in pounds.

products.name: Kuat Piston Pro X
products.priceNote: US MSRP $1,589.00 for the base 2" 2-Bike configuration (SKU PX22G), stated verbatim on the Kuat manufacturer page ("$1,589.00") and corroborated by the Mike's Bikes retailer listing ("Regular price $1,589.00", SKU PX22G).
products.provenance: The Kuat manufacturer product page (kuat.com/products/piston-pro-x, SKU PX22G) confirms this exact model as the Piston Pro X and lists the base 2"/2-Bike configuration at $1,589.00, with 67 lbs per tray, 53" max wheelbase, 5" max tire width, 18"-32" wheel range, No Frame Contact (touchless tire arms), an included hitch lock plus semi-integrated 12mm cable lock, foot-pedal fold up/down (tilt), and QuickConnect 1-/2-bike Add-Ons; its Weight spec lists the 2" 2-Bike rack at 64 lbs. Mike's Bikes (retailer) corroborates the identity via the identical SKU PX22G and barcode 857373008412, the $1,589.00 price, and a spec list confirming Bike Capacity 2, Hitch Size 1 1/4" or 2", Max Per Bike Weight 67 lbs, Max Wheelbase 53", and Max Tire Width 5"; Rack Attack additionally classifies it as Style: Platform with Locking/Tilt/Folding features. All three pages describe the same wheel-tray platform rack, confirming this is the exact Piston Pro X and not a sibling or other-capacity variant.
